area.eligibility: Open to the general public. Children under 12 must ride with an adult.
area.tripRules: Go! Santa Clarita offers service citywide.

Santa Clarita.hoursNote: The system may stop accepting new ride requests near the end of the service window. Holiday hours not stated.

notes: Agency publishes no zone map. The page says the service runs citywide, so the Santa Clarita city limits (4 polygons from LA County's City Boundaries layer, combined into one MultiPolygon) stand in for the zone. Not a transit-specific boundary; re-check if the agency publishes a zone map or GTFS-Flex. Pickup method not stated on the agency page, so it is left out.
